text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello there, Trainer. These are nice, 
crunchy pickled radishes~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I've had a soft spot for these since way 
back. I've even been allowed to pickle 
them in the dorm's rice bran bed.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I served some crunchy pickles for dinner 
to test 'em out, and everybody said they 
were super tasty~"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I thought I pickled plenty, but lately, 
I've been running short quite often.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You're all in your growing phase, after 
all. I'm planning to pickle a whole 
mountain today so you can eat to your 
heart's content~!
